channel.title: Carlos Lopez Mejia | Projects & Technical Feed
channel.description: Technical write-ups, cloud architecture designs, and AI research by Carlos Lopez Mejia.

item.title: Master's Thesis: KG Construction and Retrieval for LLM-Based Test Scenario Generation from Automotive Regulations
item.description: Designing and evaluating a structured Knowledge Graph retrieval layer to improve LLM-based generation of test scenarios (speed, load condition, and post-condition tuples) from automotive regulations (UN Regulation 152). Benchmarked against RegulaRAG, LightRAG, and HippoRAG 2.

item.title: Salsuki: Architecture & Engineering Design for a Community Platform
item.description: Full-stack community management platform built with Supabase (Postgres, Row-Level Security, Edge Functions), React 19/TypeScript on Vercel, and automated CI/CD. Includes append-only financial ledger with SUM() balance calculations and atomic [redacted] RPCs.

item.title: LECture-bot: GenAI Course Assistant with LangChain & Weaviate
item.description: Generative AI assistant for course materials built using LangChain, Weaviate vector search, and dual cloud/local LLM backends (OpenAI and Gemini API) with conversational memory and source citation.

item.title: AI Travel Journal Assistant: Full-Stack React, FastAPI & PostgreSQL
item.description: Full-stack intelligent travel companion built with React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Implements automated itinerary generation and contextual destination recommendations.

item.title: TUM IDP: LLM Tooling Framework for Research Integration
item.description: Framework designed at Technical University of Munich to bridge academic research-stage tools into production-ready software using LLMs and structured Python toolchains.

item.title: ADLM Medical Image Segmentation with nnU-Net & PyTorch
item.description: Deep learning research at TUM Chair for AI in Medicine benchmarking 3D medical image segmentation models using PyTorch, nnU-Net, and MONAI.
